task_instance: Create a small plain-Java Maven project (standard src/main/java and src/test/java layout, maven.compiler.release=21, UTF-8), write modern Java 21 idioms (a sealed interface with two record implementations and an area() method using pattern-matching switch with record patterns), add a JUnit 5 test via the junit-bom, and run 'mvn -B verify' to compile, test and package.
evidence: Runtime provides OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 (java/javac), Apache Maven 3.9.11, Gradle 8.14.3. Created project under <work>/demo with pom.xml (release 21, junit-bom 5.11.3, surefire 3.5.2), src/main/java/com/example/Shapes.java (sealed interface Shape, records Circle/Rectangle, pattern-matching switch), and src/test/java/com/example/ShapesTest.java (2 JUnit 5 tests). Ran 'mvn -B -Dmaven.repo.local=$PWD/.m2repo verify' with a work-directory-local Maven repo; Maven resolved plugins and JUnit from Maven Central through the agent proxy and finished with BUILD SUCCESS in ~15s. Verified: surefire report shows 'Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0'; target/demo-1.0.0.jar (4744 bytes) was produced and 'jar tf' lists the compiled Shapes, Shapes$Shape (sealed), Shapes$Circle, Shapes$Rectangle record classes. The skill's core deliverable (detect-less greenfield plain-Java build/verify with modern idioms and a passing test, packaged to a jar) was really produced and confirmed.
